finalText:
**Your cache server died and took the whole app down.**

All was well until 02:14:07 on July 4. Then the cache at `10.0.0.12:6379` refused every connection.

1. The app fell back to reading the main store.
2. The store could not keep up. Requests timed out at 5 seconds.
3. Waiting work piled up. The queue hit 568 against a 500 limit.
4. It retried the cache 13 times. All refused.
5. At 02:31:44 `worker-2` ran out of memory.
6. At 02:31:52 the supervisor killed everything.

No request completed after 02:14:03. The outage lasted 17 minutes 45 seconds.
